summary: Decrements a per-entry index stored in a table whose stride is 64 bytes (this + 16*a2 DWORDs), then wraps the index back toward the per-entry bound when it underflows below zero. Mirrors IncrementIndexWithWrap (0x004A5750) with reversed wrap direction: entry 0 returns a conditional dispatch call, and selector a2 == 2 first normalizes the table via FindZeroResultIndex. Invoked from pit-stop tire-compound decision and a mode-based dispatch.

local_names.this: container carrying a 64-byte-stride table of index/bound entries
local_names.a2: table entry selector; 2 also triggers table normalization, 0 returns the dispatch path

operations.description: If the entry selector a2 equals 2, call FindZeroResultIndex(this) first, normalizing the table before the decrement
Compute the entry base as this + 16*a2 DWORDs (64-byte stride table indexing); the index field lives at base+44 and the bound at base+40
Read the index at base+44, subtract 1, and write it back
If the decremented index is less than zero, wrap it: to bound-1 when the flag byte at base+53 is set, otherwise to 0, and write the wrapped value back to base+44

For selector a2 == 0 return the result of ConditionalDispatch_55e0(this) instead of the entry pointer; otherwise return the computed entry base. Called from PitStopDecisionTireCompound and ModeBasedDispatch

unresolved: Why entry 0 returns a conditional dispatch call instead of its own base pointer is not explained by this function's evidence
The meaning of the flag byte at base+53 (which selects the bound-1 vs 0 wrap direction, the reverse of IncrementIndexWithWrap) is not documented
